input: اصل الذّکر هو القیام علی المذکور و النّسیان عن ورائه.

input: رأس الانقطاع هو التّوجّه الی شطر الله و الورود علیه و النّظر الیه و الشّهادة بین یدیه.

input: رأس القدرة و الشّجاعة هی اعلآء کلمة الله و الاستقامة علی حبّه.

input: اصل العافیة هی الصّمت و النّظر الی العاقبة و الانزوآء عن البریّة.

output: i-Karmil Tablet of Carmel
prediction:
The Tablet of Carmel

Praise be unto Thee, O Lord my God! I testify that Thou hast created all things for the revelation of Thy signs, and hast ordained them to be the mirrors of Thy names. Naught have I witnessed except that it hath reminded me of Thy sovereignty and Thy power, Thy glory and Thy majesty.

By Thy grace and mercy, I have been enabled to recognize the manifestations of Thy divine attributes and to behold the evidences of Thy transcendent unity. All the atoms of the earth bear witness to the revelation of Thy oneness, and all the denizens of heaven testify unto the splendor of Thy dominion.

O Thou Who art the Lord of all being and the Desire of all hearts! Thou hast called into being all creation through the potency of Thy word, and hast breathed into every atom the spirit of Thy knowledge. The eyes of all creatures are turned towards Thee, and the hearts of all the faithful are devoted unto Thee.

I beseech Thee, O my God, by the blood of all Thy chosen ones and by the tears shed by Thy lovers in their separation from Thee, to grant unto me the grace to serve Thy Cause and to promote Thy word amongst Thy creatures. Make me a vessel for the outpouring of Thy mercy, and a channel for the revelation of Thy bounties.

Verily, Thou art the All-Knowing, the All-Wise, the All-Powerful, and the All-Merciful.
